resources.string: Make your TV feel like home. Connect your phone to the same Wi-Fi as your NetFelix server.
Open links using your browser. This app stays connected to your NetFelix server.
Could not reach NetFelix. Check the address, Wi-Fi and server, then reconnect.
No photo picker is available on this phone.
Enter only your server address, for example http://192.168.1.15:8092
Export failed. Check the server and try again.
No server found. Use the same Wi-Fi, allow UDP 8093, or enter the server address.
Found NetFelix. Tap Connect to my TV.
Control your paired computers. Screen, mouse, keyboard and file sessions open in RustDesk. Approve each connection on the laptop.
Enter a name and a valid RustDesk ID.
Connect to the NetFelix server and refresh before opening a laptop.
Server setup copied. In RustDesk, open Settings → Network → ID/Relay server → Import server config.
RustDesk provides the encrypted screen, mouse, keyboard and file-transfer session. Install its Android client once, then return here.
Open the download link in your browser.
Server setup loaded. Ready to connect.
Could not load laptop setup. Check the server address and Wi-Fi, then refresh.
